name: 玩趣修复凝霜
opItems: Wet Kelco-care™ into Glycerin of phase A2, add it to phase A1, stir gently and heat to 70°C.
In a separate beaker, prepare ingredients of phase B and heat it to 70°C.
Add phase B to phase A while homogenizing.
Cool down to 35°C under moderate stirring.
Add ingredients of phase C, D and E under gentle stirring.

name: 反重力精华
opItems: Heat water of A1 to 75°C and disperse Jaguar HP-105 under high shear (2000-2500 rpm) for 15 min.
Prepare premix A2 and add to A1 under moderate mixing for 10 min.
Prepare A3 by dispersing Pullulan into water heated to 75°C.
When A3 is homogeneous, add to A1+A2 and mix slowly for 10 min.
Add A4 to A1+A2+A3 (N.B. phase A is not translucent) at 70°C and mix under high shear (2000-2500 rpm) until homogenization, then cool to 50°C.
Prepare B and add to A at 50°C under high shear (2000-2500 rpm) for 15 min.
Cool under moderate mixing, then below 40°C add C.
Add D.

name: 抗斑身体喷雾
opItems: Heat water to 75°C, add slowly Kelco-Care™ Diutan Gum under rapid mixing and let the gel swells for 5 min.
Prepare B1 and heat at 55°C. Add B2 to B1.
Add B (50°C) to A (50°C) under rapid mixing (2500 rpm). Mix for 5 min.
Add C under mixing. Mix for 1 min.
Cool to 35°C and add D and E under mixing.
Cool to 25°C under mixing.

name: 香蕉奶油冰淇淋
opItems: Heat water and propanediol of A1 to 75°C and disperse Maisita 9040 under mixing until homogenization.
Prepare premix A2 and add to A1. Mix for 5 min.
Disperse Eumulgin® SG in water of A3 and add to A1+A2 under mixing.
Prepare B and heat to 75°C.
Emulsification: add B to A under high shear (2500 rpm) for 10 min.
Cool under moderate shear and add C.
Continue cooling under mixing until 35°C then add D.
Adjust pH with E.

name: 胡须梳理霜
opItems: Heat water and glycerin to 75°C and add Avicel® PC 591 under mixing.
Continue mixing for about 15 minutes.
Add Satiaxane™ CX91 under mixing.
Prepare A and heat to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (Rotor/Stator 3000rpm), add A to B.
Mix for about 10 minutes.
Cool under mixing and at about 35°C, add C.

name: 弹力眼霜
opItems: In the main vessel, heat the water of phase A1 between 50-60°C in order to better disperse STÄRKINA NATURAL. Disperse with high shear for 10 minutes (TIP: if the water is too hot, Stärkina creates agglomerates that are difficult to disperse. In case it happens one can disperse with rotor stator to break the agglomerates).
Prepare the premix of phase A2, add to A1 and disperse with high shear for 5 minutes. Then heat phase A1+A2 at 70°C.
Prepare oil phase B and heat at 70°C. Check that everything is well melted.
Proceed with the emulsion of oil phase B into water phase A1+A2 at 70°C under high shear (rotor stator at 2500-3000 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Cool down under moderate mixing until reaching 40°C.
Below 40°C, add ingredients of phase C one by one and stir under medium shear, until everything is completely incorporated.
Finish to cool down, check pH and adjust with phase D.

name: 焦糖面膜
opItems: Prepare B: heat water and glycerin to 60°C and disperse Jaguar HP-105 using a deflocculating turbine.
Mix for 10 min.
Prepare A and heat to 75°C.
Add A heated to 75°C to B+C heated to 60°C without mixing, then under moderate shear with a deflocculating turbine.
Cool under mixing and at about 35°C, add the other ingredients.
Mix under moderate shear for about 5 min.

name: 佛手瓜奇异果绵绵冰面霜
opItems: Weigh phase A1 and heat to 70°C.
Disperse phase A2 into phase A1 under moderate mixing.
Prepare phase A3 by dispersing Kelcogel into water.
Add phase A3 to A1+A2 under moderate mixing.
Heat phase B to 70°C and emulsify. Add B into A and mix under high shear for 5 minutes.
Cool down until 35°C and add one by one phase C.
Adjust pH with phase D.

name: CICA屏障霜
opItems: Prepare phase A1 into the main vessel and heat at 65-70°C.
Add phase A2 and disperse Avicel® PC 591 with rotor stator (3000rpm) until homogeneous.
Add phase A3 and disperse Eumulgin® SG with rotor stator (3000rpm) until homogeneous. Then heat at 70-72°C
In the melter, prepare phase B and heat at 70-72°C.
Proceed with the emulsion at 70-72°C: under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000rpm) and add slowly phase B into Phase A1+A2+A3.
Homogenize for 10 minutes with rotor stator at 3000rpm.
Cool under normal stirring and at about 25°C, add Phase C, D, and E.

name: 舒缓身体乳膏
opItems: Heat water to 70-75°C and disperse phase A2 under mixing.
Prepare and heat phase B to 80°C.
Under rapid mixing, at 70°C, add slowly phase B to phase A1+A2 to create the emulsion.
Cool under rapid mixing (dispersing mixer) and at about 25°C, add C, D and E.
Complete cooling under rapid mixing (dispersing mixer 5 min)

name: 宇宙变色眼影

specRows.label: Viscosity Brookfield RV (spindle C, speed 5)
specRows.value: approx. 52000 mPa.s at t0 approx. 125000 mPa.s after 24h Viscosity is stabilized after 24h

opItems: Heat phase B at 75-80°C. Check that all ingredients are melted (could present some turbidity due to Emulium® Dolcea MB) and maintain at 75°C.
Heat water of phase A1 at 75°C, add Avicel® PC 591 and disperse under high shear with rotor stator for 10 minutes. Check homogeneity.
Add premix A2 into A1 and disperse under high shear with rotor stator for 15 minutes. Check homogeneity.
Proceed with the emulsion of phase B into phase A at 75°C under medium shear, and then increase to high shear (3000 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Cool down under moderate shear and below 40°C add phase C. Mix under moderate shear for 10-15 minutes (do not use rotor stator, only mixing tools).
Below 30°C add phase D under very slow mixing until it is homogeneous. Do not use rotor stator : the beads of incapsulated pigments are very fragile, it requires slow mixing.
Finish to cool down until reaching 25°C. Check the pH and adjust if necessary.

name: 松软酪酪面霜
opItems: Heat water of phase A1 to 55°C and disperse Starkina with high shear using a turbine stirrer.
Prepare premix A2 and add it into phase A1.
Weigh ingredients of phase B and heat it to 75°C.
Heat A1+A2 to 75°C.
Add phase B to phase A1+A2 and homogenize under high shear.
Cool under moderate shear.
Add ingredients of phase C one by one.
Adjust pH with phase D.

name: 疯狂哑光发蜡
opItems: Add A2 into A1 under rapid mixing for 10 minutes.
Add A3 into A1+A2 under mixing for 10 minutes.
Heat A and B to 70°C.
Add B into A at 70°C, under rapid mixing, for 10 minutes.
Cool.
Add C at 30°C under mixing.
Complete cooling.

name: 奶油遮瑕棒
opItems: Prepare phase A in the main vessel and heat at 85°C. Control that everything is melted and that the phase is homogeneous.

In another vessel prepare the pigment phase B: wet pigments with the other ingredients and use a three-roll mill to get a homogeneous paste. Add phase B into phase A at 85°C and disperse with rotor stator. Control that everything is well dispersed.
Add powder phase C into phase A+B at 85°C and disperse with rotor stator. Control that everything is well dispersed.
Add phase D under stirring and mix until everything is homogeneous.
Pour at 80°C ± 2°C in a mold previously heated at 40°C.
Let cool down at room temperature and then freeze for 15-20 minutes.

name: 卷发护发乳
opItems: Heat water of A1 to 75°C, prepare premix Glycerin + Solagum Tara and add to water under mixing (1000 rpm) during 15 min.
Heat water of A2 to 75°C and disperse Tapioca Starch under moderate shear (1000-1200 rpm) during 15 min.
Add A2 to A1 under moderate shear.
Add A3 to A1+A2 and heat to 70-75°C.
Prepare B, heat to 70-75°C and add to A. Then mix under moderate shear (800-1000 rpm) in order to homogeneize.
Cool down to 50°C and add C, increase the speed for 5 min (1500 rpm).
Cool and at 35°C adjust the pH with E.

name: 日用轻盈保湿霜
opItems: Heat water at 70°C and disperse Avicel® PC 591 under mixing. Homogenize for 10 minutes under high speed.
Premix xanthan gum and glycerin, add it to A1, and maintain mixing for 10 minutes.
Heat B up to 70°C and stir until complete solubilization.
Under high shear, add B (70°C) to A (70°C), and homogenize for 10 minutes.
Cool under mixing up to 35°C, then add C and stir for 5 minutes.
Complete cooling to 25°C under mixing

name: 日用防晒霜 SPF20
opItems: Heat A1 to 80°C.
Prepare A2, add A3 and grind it 3 times with the three roll mill.
Add A2+A3 to A1.
Prepare B and add to A under mixing (deflocculator, 3000 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Reduce mixing to 1000 rpm and add C, mix until homogenization.
Add D and mix until homogenization.

name: 纤长睫毛膏
opItems: Heat B1 at 80°C. Check that all ingredients are well melted and maintain the phase at 80°C.
Heat the water of phase A1 at 80°C and add phase A2 by dispersing it with medium/high shear for 10 minutes.
Add A3 into A1+A2 with medium shear for 30 minutes.
Add A4 into A1+A2+A3 with medium shear. Disperse under Ultra Turrax for 10 minutes to properly disperse the pigment and homogenize all the A phases.
Check that everything is dispersed homogeneously. Keep temperature at 80°C.
Add B2 into B1.

Proceed with the emulsion of Phases B (B1+B2) into Phases A (A1+A2+A3+A4) at 80°C under medium shear, and then increase to high shear (3000 rpm) for 15 minutes. Be careful not to exceed 80°C because of the high shear.
Cool down by stages of 5-10°C with moderate stirring.
Below 35-30°C add ingredient of phase C, D and E one by one under moderate stirring.
Finish to cool down the product at 25°C.

name: 梦幻云霜
opItems: Heat water and glycerin of phase A1 at 75°C, add Avicel® PC 591 and disperse under high shear (rotor stator 3000rpm) during 15 minutes until complete homogeneity.
Add phase A2 into A1 at 75°C. Disperse under high shear for 10 minutes. Check that everything is homogeneous.
Heat the oil phase B at 75°C.
Proceed with the emulsion of phase B into phase A at 75°C under high shear (3000 rpm) in order to add as much air as possible and maintain the high shear for 10 minutes.
Cool down under low shear in order not to break air bubbles. The cool down process could take up to 90 minutes, but this is a very important step.
Under 30°C, add phases C, D, E and F one by one, always under low shear.
Check pH and adjust if necessary.

name: 干爽防晒乳 SPF50
opItems: Heat water at 75°C and add under mixing Kelco-Care™ Diutan Gum, let the gel swell for 5 min, then add A2.
Heat B at 80°C under mixing until complete solubilization of UV filters.
Add B (75°C) slowly to A (75°C) under rapid mixing (2000 rpm) for 15 min.
Add C at 60°C and mix for 5 min at 2000 rpm.
Cool to 40-45°C, add premix D to the emulsion and homogenize with rotor stator for 2 min.
Prepare E and add to the emulsion under moderate mixing.
Cool to 30°C, add F and G and mix for 5 min.

name: 母婴修护膏
opItems: Heat A to 85 °C, maintain for 10 minutes and cool slowly under normal mixing.
At about 45 °C increase the mixing speed (Rotor/Stator 2 500 rpm).
At 35 °C add B then mix until completely cooled.

name: 活力焕肤底霜
opItems: Heat the water of phase A1 at 75°C and disperse with high shear Avicel® PC 611 for 15 minutes.
Prepare the premix of phase A2 and add into A1 with moderate shear for 5-10 minutes until homogeneous. Maintain phase A1+A2 at 70°C.
Heat phase B at 70°C.
Proceed with the emulsion at 70°C: add phase B into A and mix under high shear (3000 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Cool down under moderate shear and below 35-40°C add the ingredients of phase C one by one.
Adjust pH with phase D.

name: 轻盈滋润日用面霜
opItems: Heat A1 at 75°C.
Pour under moderate shear with a dispersing mixer A2 into A1 for 10 minutes.
Solubilize A3 by heating to 60°C and add it into A1+A2.
Heat B to 75°C.
Make the emulsion : Add B into A under high shear for 10 minutes.
Cool and below 40°C add ingredients of C one by one.
Ajust pH with D.

name: 万用润肤霜
opItems: Heat A to 85°C for 15 min.
Cool A under moderate mixing until 50°C.
Heat B1 to 50°C and mix until homogenization.
Add B2 into B1 under mixing.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3 000 rpm), add B to A at 50°C for 10 min.
Cool by steps under rapid mixing (2 500 rpm).
At about 35°C, add C.
Complete cooling under rapid mixing.

name: 极致柔软防晒霜 SPF30
opItems: Heat water to 75°C, then add slowly Kelco-Care™ Diutan Gum under stirring and let the gel swell for 5 min.
Heat B to 82°C under stirring until complete solubilisation of UV filters and polymer.
Add slowly B to A at 75°C under rapid mixing (2000 rpm) for 15 min.
Cool to 45°C under moderate mixing (1000 rpm).
Prepare C (thick paste) and then add to A+B under rapid mixing. Homogenize with ultra turrax for 2 min to make sure to properly disperse Sunhancer™ Eco SPF Booster.
Cool to 30°C under moderate mixing and add D then E.
Complete cooling.

name: 柔滑润肤露 SPF50

specRows.value: Conform to Australian, EU, Japan, UK, MERCOSUR, and China regulations

opItems: Heat demineralized water at 75°C and add Kelco-Care™ diutan gum under stirring then let the gel swell under mixing for 10min.
Add A2.
Heat phase B2 at 78°C under stirring until complete solubilization of the UV filters, then let it cool to 70-75°C.
Then add B1 into B2 and stir until complete solubilization.
Add B (70°C) to A (70°C) under stirring and homogenize for 10 min at 2000rpm.
Then cool to 50°C under mixing 1000rpm.
Add phase C premixed to emulsion under stirring and homogenize for 2min at 2000rpm.
Cool to 35°C and add one by one under mixing phases D, E, and F.
Complete cooling to 25°C under mixing.

name: 全面防护粉底液
opItems: Heat A1 up to 60°C and homogenize under stirring (1000 rpm) for 5 min.
Disperse A2 under stirring and then homogenize with ultra turrax (10 000 rpm) for 2 min, then add to A1.
Prepare A3: heat DPPG at 60°C, add slowly pigments under stirring and stir for 10 min. Then use a three roll mill to smooth the dispersion.
Add A3 to A1+ A2 and homogenize with rotor stator (2500 rpm) for 5 min.
Heat B up to 50°C.
Add B (50°C) to A (60°C) under mixing and homogenize with rotor stator (3000 rpm) for 5 min.
Prepare C: premix and homogenize with ultra turrax (10 000 rpm) for 2 min.
Cool A+B to 40°C and add C. Then homogenize with rotor stator (3000 rpm) for 2 min.
Cool under moderate mixing.

name: 粉色果冻乳液
opItems: Weight Original Extract™ Cranberry Bio of phase A1 and add Carbopol® Ultrez 10 under stirring.
Add premix A2 into A1 and mix under medium shear for 10 minutes. Check that everything is homogeneous.
Pre-neutralize the carbomer before emulsification by adding A3 into A1+A2.
Mix oil phase B until homogeneous.
Proceed with the emulsion. Add slowly B into A under medium shear and then increase to high shear (3000 rpm) for 10-15 minutes.
Finalize neutralization of the carbomer by adding phase C under moderate mixing.
Finally add D, E and F. Check that everything is well dispersed.

name: 闪光软糖固体高光
opItems: Heat water of phase A1 to 80°C.
Disperse Pemupur™ Start Polymer into phase A1 for 10 minutes under rapid mixing (2000 rpm), maintain heating to 80°C.
Under rapid mixing (2000 rpm), add Kelcogel to the water+dyes of phase A2, heat to 80°C, mix until homogenous.
Add phase A1 into phase A2 and heat up to 85°C.
Prepare phase B and heat to 85°C.
Under rapid mixing (Rotor/Stator 3000 rpm), add phase B to phase A, maintain rapid mixing for about 5 min until homogenous, add phase C and mix again.
Then pour into the mold/stick at minimum 60°C and let cool down for 30 minutes.

name: 薄荷玩趣足部护理霜
opItems: Disperse A2 into A1 and mixing 5 minutes.
Heat A1+A2 and B to 90°C.
Add B slowly to A1+A2 and maintain under rapid mixing for 5 minutes.
Add C and maintain under rapid mixing for 5 minutes, at 85°C.
Cooling slowly and at 55°C, add D, E and F under mixing.
At 50°C, put quickly in the pack.

name: 头部护理泥膜
opItems: Under mixing, disperse Avicel® PC 591 into water of B1 heated to 75°C.
Continue mixing for about 10 min.
Prepare B2 and homogenize, then under mixing add to B1 and continue mixing for about 5 min.
Add B3 to B1+B2 under mixing.
Prepare A and heat to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm), add A heated to 75°C to B heated to 75°C.
Maintain rapid mixing for about 10 min.
Cool under mixing and at about 35°C, add C and D.
Complete cooling.

name: 高遮瑕粉底液
opItems: In the main vessel, mix phase A.
Add ingredients of phase B one by one and disperse with Ultra Turrax for 5 minutes. Check that everything is dispersed homogeneously.

Prepare the pigment phase C: wet pigments with Labrafac™ CC MB and Emulium® Illustro, and use a three roll mill to get a homogeneous paste. Add to phase A+B and disperse the pigment paste with high shear or Ultra Turrax.
Check that everything is dispersed homogeneously.
Prepare water phase D and solubilize the electrolytes.
Proceed with the emulsion of phase D into phase A+B+C at room temperature under medium shear, and then increase to high shear (3000 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Under moderate shear add the powder of phase E. Mix under moderate shear for 5 minutes.
Add then phase F and phase G one by one.

name: 高效防护乳 SPF50
opItems: Heat water to 75°C and add under stirring Kelco Care Diutan, let the gel swell for 5 min, then add A2 and A3
under stirring.
Heat B1 to 80°C under stirring until complete solubilization of UV filters.
Heat B2 to 70°C, add TiO 2 slowly under mixing and homogenize for 5 min.
Add B2 to B1.
Add B (75°C) slowly to A (75°C) under mixing (2000 rpm) for 15 min.
Add C and mix for 5 min at 2000 rpm.
Cool to 35°C under medium speed mixing (1000 rpm).
Add D under mixing and homogenize for 2 min.
Complete cooling to 25°C under stirring.

name: 细致柔滑长效防水眼线笔
opItems: Weight ingredients of phase A and heat at 75°C.
In a separate beaker, disperse Avicel® PC 591 of phase B into water, previously heated to 75°C, mix under high shear (rotor stator/ ultra turrax) for about 10 min.
Under rapid mixing, add Vanatural of phase B and maintain mixing with high shear for about 10 min. Then, add xanthan gum of phase B with moderate speed.
Under rapid mixing (Rotor/Stator 3000 rpm), slowly add phase A to phase B until homogenous.
Cool under moderate mixing to 35°C, add phase C and control the color.
Adjust pH with phase D if necessary (pH value 7.3-8.3).

name: 保湿润色润唇膏
opItems: Heat phase A at 85°C, mix slowly and control that everything is melted and homogeneous.
Add the powder of phase B and disperse with Ultra Turrax (2000rpm) for 5 minutes.
Prepare the premix C, by wetting the pigment, and grind with a 3 roll mill. Control that the dispersion is homogeneous.
Add premix C into A+B (85°C) and disperse with Ultra Turrax (2000rpm) for 5 minutes.
Prepare the premix D at 65°C. It will form a homogenous paste.
Add premix D (65°C) into A+B+C (85°C) and disperse with Ultra Turrax (2000rpm) for 5 minutes.
Add phase E into A+B+C+D at 85°C. Mix slowly.
Pour at 82°C ±2°C in a lipstick mold previously heated at 40°C. No need to use silicone spray into the mold.
Let cool down 30 minutes at room temperature and then freeze for 20 minutes.

name: 冰霜焕肤日霜
opItems: Prepare A.
Under mixing, add Novemer™ EC-2 to water of phase B, then under rapid mixing, add Cosmedia® SP.
Continue rapid mixing until homogeneity of phase B.
Prepare C and D, then add to B.
Add A on top of B+C+D before mixing then mix quickly (Rotor/Stator 3000 rpm).
Continue rapid mixing for about 15 minutes.
Cool if necessary.

name: 冰爽眼霜
opItems: Prepare in the main vessel the oil phase A, heat at 80°C and disperse Bentone Gel® under medium to high shear. Control homogeneity of the phase.
Prepare water phase B and heat at 80°C.
Proceed with the emulsion of phase B into phase A at 80°C under rapid mixing, then maintain high shear (Rotor/Stator 3000 rpm) during 10 min.
Prepare phase C and add to phase A+B at 80°C. Mix until homogeneous.
Add phase D and mix under medium shear until everything is incorporated.
Cool down under medium shear and at 74°C+/-2°C pour directly into the bottom filled packaging or into the mold.

name: 亮眼精华液

specRows.label: Aspect
specRows.value: Soft white emulsion with slight pink iridescence

opItems: In the main vessel, weight phase A1 and heat at 75°C. Disperse Structure® XL under high shear for 10 minutes. Check that everything is well dispersed.
Prepare the premix of phase A2 and add it into A1. Disperse for 5 minutes until homogeneous. Set the temperature at 70°C.
Add oil phase A3 (not necessarily previously heated) into A1+A2 and heat at 70°C. Once melted, proceed with the emulsion under high shear (2000-3000rpm) for 10 minutes.
Cool down until reaching 40°C under moderate mixing.

Add Jeechem® NDA-LC (volatile oil) of phase B and mix under high shear for 10 minutes. Check that everything is homogenous. This specific process permits to use a low flashpoint oil without taking the risk to evaporate it.
Continue to cool down and below 30°C, add the ingredients of phase C, D, E, one by one and disperse under medium shear. Check that everything is well incorporated.
Finish to cool down, check pH and adjust with phase F.

name: 瞬亮有色霜

specRows.label: pH
specRows.value: 5.3 ± 0.2 (due to the preservative, pH of aqueous phase is adjusted under 5.5)

opItems: Prepare phase A: Disperse Avicel into water heated to 80°C and mix for about 15 min and add slowly under stirring premix of xanthan gum and glycerin, stir for 5min then add Amphisol® K at 70°C under mixing, mix for 2 min.
Prepare phase B and heat to 70°C.
Under rapid mixing (Rotor/Stator 3000 rpm), add B to A slowly.
Continue rapid mixing for about 10 min then let it cool under mixing.
At about 40°C, add phase C and phase D.
Prepare G by grinding it 3 times with a three-roll mill.
Complete cooling and at about 30°C, add E, F, G and H. Mix for 15 min.

name: 强效营养护发膏
opItems: Prepare A1 and heat to 75°C.
Prepare A2: under mixing, add Actigum CS 11 QD, then the premix Glycerin + Satiaxane VPC 911 to water and heat to 75°C.
Under slow mixing, add A3 to A1+A2. - Prepare B and heat to 75°C.
Without mixing, add B to A, then mix slowly (around 400 rpm) with a defloculent (no rotor stator).
Continue mixing at around 400 rpm for about 10 min. - Cool under slow mixing and at about 35°C, add C.

name: 高效防护防晒霜 SPF50

specRows.value: Conform to Australian, EU, Japan, UK, MERCOSUR, and China regulations
* Tests conducted on a similar formula (1704-1.23). In vitro measurement highlights same absorbance curve.

opItems: Mix A1.
Premix A2, add to A1 and stir until complete dispersion of xanthan gum. Then heat at 60°C and add A3.
Add A4 under high shear (Ultra Turrax is possible to make sure there are no lumps of gel), then add A5 and stir until complete solubilization of EDTA.
Mix A6 until complete solubilization of Parsol® HS and then add to batch.
Heat B1 at 80°C until complete solubilization of UV filters, then let it cool to 60°C and add B2, stir until complete solubilization then add B3 and homogenize.
Add slowly B (60°C) into A (60°C) under mixing and homogeneize for 15min at 2000rpm.
Cool down to 35°C under moderate mixing (about 800rpm) and add premix C under stirring.
Add D to adjust final pH at 7.2 and stir for 10min. If needed to have a thinner emulsion, adding 1min of high shear is possible.

name: 柠檬凝乳面膜
opItems: Add glycerin to water of A and heat to 75°C under mixing.
Add Structure XL and mix for about 10 min, then add Natrosol Plus and mix for about 10 min.
Add B to A. - Prepare C and heat to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm) add C to A+B, maintain rapid mixing for about 10 min.
At about 50°C, add D under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm).
Maintain mixing for about 5 min then cool under slow mixing.
At about 35°C, add other ingredients of E.

name: 岩浆面膜
opItems: Prepare A and heat to 85°C.
Prepare B: weigh Surfhope C-1616 and add Hydramol TGL, mix until homogenization, then add water and heat to 75°C.
Prepare C and heat to 75°C under mixing for about 20-25 min until homogenization.
Add C to A.
Under rapid mixing (3000 rpm), add B to A+C and mix for about 10 min.
Add D, E and F and pour at around 50°C.

name: 纤长睫毛打底膏

specRows.label: Viscosity Brookfield RV (spindle B, speed 5)
specRows.value: approx. 40000 mPa.s at t0 approx. 70000 mPa.s after 24h

opItems: Heat B at 85°C. Check that all ingredients are melted (could present some turbidity due to Emulium® Dolcea MB) and maintain the phase at 85°C.
Heat the water of phase A1 at 70°C. Add Avicel® PC591 and Satiaxane™ VPC 911 one by one and disperse under medium/high shear for 15 minutes each. Check that everything is dispersed homogeneously.
Add phase A2 to phase A1 and disperse with Ultra Turrax for 10 minutes. Check that everything is dispersed homogeneously. Heat the water phase A1+A2 at 85°C.
Proceed with the emulsion of phase B into phase A (A1+A2) at 85°C under medium shear, and then increase to high shear (3000 rpm) for 10-15 minutes.
Cool down by stages of 5-10°C with moderate stirring, and below 45°C add phase C.
Finish to cool down until reaching 25°C. Adjust pH if necessary (phase D).

specRows.label: Conform to worldwide regulations SPF in vivo (ISO 24444)

name: 极简柔肤霜
opItems: Prepare oily phase A and heat to 75°C.
In the main vessel, prepare phase B adding structure Solanace to water at room temperature, then heat at about 75°C under mixing until homogeneous.
Add C into B with high shear. Check the homogeneity.
Emulsify A into B+C at about 75°C under mixing (deflocculating turbine 3000 rpm), and mix for about 10 min.
Cool down under mixing.
Adjust the pH if necessary.

name: 保湿身体喷雾
opItems: Heat phase A1 at 70-75°C.
Phase A2: Disperse gellan and xanthan gums into glycerin and then add into Phase A1, previously heated at 70-75°C.
Phase A3: Heat water at 70°C and solubilize Amphisol® K. When A3 is homogeneous, add into A1+A2.
In the melter, prepare phase B and heat at 70-75°C.
Proceed with the emulsion at 70-75°C: under stirring (2000 rpm), add phase B into Phase A1+A2+A3.
Homogenize for 5 min with rotor stator at 3000rpm.
Cool under normal stirring and at about 45°C, add Phase C.
Adjust pH with D.
Cool under normal stirring until 25°C.

name: 多功能眼影
opItems: Heat phase B at 75°C. Check that all ingredients are melted and maintain at 75°C.

In the main vessel, prepare phase A. Heat water at 75°C and add AVICEL® PC 591 and SATIAXANE™ VPC 911 one by one and disperse with high shear for 15-20 minutes each. Add the VANATURAL® under Ultra Turrax for 5 min at 75°C. Maintain the water phase A at 75°C.
Proceed with the emulsion of phase B into phase A at 75°C under medium shear, and then increase to high shear (3000 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Cool down under moderate shear and below 40°C add phase C. Mix under moderate shear for 10-15 minutes.
Finish to cool down until reaching 25°C. Check the pH and adjust if necessary.

name: 维生素唤能柔肤乳
opItems: Under mixing, disperse A2 into A1 heated to 80°C, maintain mixing for about 20 min.
Prepare premix A3 and add to A1+A2, maintain mixing for about 10 min.
Heat A4 to 80°C and add to A1+A2+A3.
Prepare B and heat to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm), add B to A1+A2+A3+A4 at about 70°C.
Maintain rapid mixing for about 10 min.
Cool under mixing and at about 30°C, add C, D and E.
Complete cooling.

name: 天然贴肤粉底液
opItems: Under rapid mixing disperse A2 into the water for 10 minutes, then A3 for another 10 minutes.
Add B to A then heat to 70°C maximum.
Under rapid mixing, add C heated to 70°C to A+B.
Maintain rapid mixing for 15 minutes.
Cool under mixing and add D, E then F at 40°C.
Complete cooling.

name: 天然无暇粉底液

specRows.value: Due to the preservative system, pH of the aqueous phase is adjusted under 5.5

opItems: COLD PROCESS (except preparation of A)
Prepare A in advance: heat A to 93-95°C and mix at the same time.
Prepare C and pass it through a three roll mill 3 times.
Prepare D: add Aerosil 200 to the ingredients of D, mix until homogenization.
Add B to A.
Add C to A+B.
Add D to A+B+C.
Prepare E, then under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm) add E to A+B+C+D.
Continue rapid mixing for about 10 min.
If necessary, cool under mixing and add the others components.

name: 颈部&法令纹嫩肤霜
opItems: Heat water of A1 to 75°C and disperse Actigum CS 11 QD under high shear (2000 rpm) for 15 min.
Prepare premix A2 and add to A1.
Heat B to 75°C.
Add B to A under high shear (2500 rpm) for 10 min.
Cool under moderate shear and at 35°C, add C.
Add D to ajust pH.

name: 安睡固体护理油

specRows.label: Aspect
specRows.value: Translucent and shiny cream gel, purple color.

opItems: Prepare phase A: mix very slowly and heat to 75°C until Amphisol® K is solubilized.
Prepare phase B and heat to 75°C.
At 70°C, add phase B to phase A without mixing at first, then mix slowly (dispersing mixer max 1000 rpm).
Cool under slow mixing and at about 40°C, add phase C and phase D
Adjust pH with phase E.
Complete cooling at about 30°C.

name: 营养头皮乳
opItems: Disperse Avicel PC 611 into water of A1 heated to 75°C.
Prepare premix Glycerin + Satiaxane VPC 911 and add to A1.
Prepare B and heat to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rmp), add B to A.
Continue rapid mixing for about 10 min.
Cool under mixing and at about 35°C, add the others ingredients.

name: 户外热身防晒霜SPF50+
opItems: Prepare A1.
Premix A2 and add to A1. Mix until the Xanthan Gum swells.
Heat A1+A2 up to 78°C.
Prepare A3 and heat up to 78°C to perfectly solubilize Amphisol® K; then add to A1+A2.
Add A4 and mix for a few minutes until complete solubilization of EDTA.
Add A5.
Prepare B1 and heat up to 81°C under mixing until perfect solubilization of UV filters.
Add B2 to B1 and homogenize with Ultra-Turrax for 2 minutes.
Add slowly B to A at 78°C and mix for 10-15 minutes at 1500 rpm.
Cool to 35°C under mixing (about 800 rpm) a d add C.
Complete cooling to 25-27°C under mixing.

name: 完美肌肤晚霜
opItems: Heat A1 to 75°C and disperse A2 with a propeller (2000 rpm) for 20 min.
Prepare premix A3, heat to 70°C and add to A1+A2 under slow mixing to avoid foam.
Heat B to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm), add B to A and mix for 10 min.
Cool to 35°C and add ingredients of C one by one.
Adjust pH with D.
Cool under mixing

name: 防晒粉棒SPF50+
opItems: Heat A to 75°C until complete solubilization.
Prepare B1 and heat to 60°C at least (for dispersion) and homogenize with ultra turrax for 6 min*.
Add B2 and homogeneize with ultra turrax for 6 min*.
Add B (at least 60°C) to A (75°C) and homogenize with ultra turrax for 2 min*.
Add C and homogenize with ultra turrax for 2 min*.
Pour at about 60°C.

name: 妆前转换霜
opItems: Heat ingredient of phase A to 80°C while stirring with moderate speed.
Solubilize ingredients of phase B and adjust pH below 5.5 with citric acid (10%). Heat it to 70°C.
Emulsify phase B into phase A at 70°C under rapid stirring
Cool down to 35°C with moderate mixing.
Add ingredients of phase C, D, E, one by one, with rapid stirring, especially for phase D.

name: 纯净液晶乳
opItems: Prepare A and heat to 75°C.
Mix slowly (700 rpm) for about 10 min.
Increase the speed to 1000 rpm to homogenize then add B.

name: 高保湿孔雀石精华
opItems: Heat water and propanediol of A1 to 75°C then disperse bentonite under high shear for 15 min.
Prepare premix A2 and add to A1 under moderate mixing.
Add A3 to A1+A2 (it is not limpid, it is normal), let it melt at around 70°C.
Mix A under high shear then cool.
Prepare B and add it to A1+A2+A3 at 50°C under high shear for 5 min.
Cool under moderate shear then under 40°C add C.
Adjust pH with D.

name: 焕彩亮肤霜
opItems: Solubilize phase A1.
In another vessel prepare phase A2, making the premix with glycerin and xanthan gum. Once homogeneous, add into A1 and disperse with rotor stator (2000 RPM) for 5-10 minutes. Check the homogeneity.
In the main vessel, weigh phase B. Disperse the Bentone gel® with rotor stator (2000 RPM) for 5-10 minutes. Check the homogeneity.
Proceed with the emulsion: Add slowly (A1+A2) into B and increase step by step the mixing speed until reaching 3000 RPM, for 10-15 minutes.
Under moderate stirring add ingredients of phase C one by one.

name: 重塑身体霜
opItems: Disperse C into water of B heated to 60°C, mix for about 10 min.
Add D and mix for about 10 min. - Heat B+C+D to 75°C.
Prepare A and heat to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (3000 rpm), add A to B+C+D and mix for about 10 min.
Cool under mixing and at about 35°C, add E, F and G.

name: 泛红急救霜
opItems: Heat phase A1 at 93-95°C to solubilize Magnesium Stearate and to obtain an homogenous gel (could take up to 45 minutes depending on mixing rate).
Add emollients of Phase A2 into Phase A1 and maintain at 93-95°C. Sprinkle Rheopearl MKL2 under high sheer during 10-20 minutes, until phase creates an homogenous gel.
Cool down to 85°C and add A3 to A1+A2. Mix until waxes are melted and phase is uniform.
Prepare premix A4 by wetting out pigments and run through the three roll mill 3 times.
Add A4 to Phase A1/A2/A3 at 75°C and mix under high sheer with rotor stator for 10-15 minutes until uniform.
Prepare water phase B by dissolving magnesium sulfate and heat to 75°C.
Proceed with the emulsion of water phase B1 into oil phase A at 75°C under rapid mixing and then increase to high shear (3000 rpm) for 15 minutes.
Cool down under medium speed (1000 rpm) until reaching 45°C and add Phase C. Continue to cool down until 30-35°C and add Phase D.
Under 30°C, add phase E under VERY SLOW mixing until it is homogeneous. DO NOT USE ROTOR STATOR: the beads of incapsulated pigments are highly shear sensitive so it requires slow mixing.
Check conformity of the bulk at 25°C, then unload the bulk at 25°C.

name: 清爽保护双凝胶防晒SPF30

specRows.label: Aspect
specRows.value: Glossy and slightly yellow fluid emulsion
Conform to Australian, EU, Japan, UK and China regulations

opItems: Heat water at 75°C, add slowly under stirring premix of xanthan gum and butylene glycol, then stirr for 5 min.
Add A2 and A3 to A and mix for 5 min.
Prepare B and heat at 82°C under stirring until complete solubilization of UV filters.
Add slowly B (75°C) to A (75°C) under rapid mixing (2000 rpm) for 15 min.
Cool to 45°C under moderate mixing (1000 rpm).
Premix C and add to the emulsion under rapid mixing.
Cool to 30°C under moderate mixing, premix D and add to the emulsion. If Corn PO4 is added at a too high temperature, it swells and increases emulsion viscosity.
Complete cooling to 25°C.

name: 焕新卸妆膏
opItems: Prepare A1 and heat to 85°C for about 15 min.
Disperse A2 into A1 with ultra-turrax for about 5 min.
Prepare B1 and heat to 70°C, then add B2 in B1.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm), add B to A.
Maintain rapid mixing for about 10 min.
Cool under moderate mixing.
Complete cooling.

name: 重置肌肤晚霜
opItems: Disperse Natrosol Plus 330 CS into water of B1 heated to 60°C, mix for about 10 minutes.
Add Satiaxane VPC 911 and mix for about 10 minutes.
Heat B1+B2 at 55°C.
Prepare A and heat to 65°C.
Under mixing (defloculator 3000 rpm), add A to B1+B2 and mix for 10 minutes.
Add C below 50°C and mix for 5 minutes under high shear.
Cool under mixing until 35°C, then add D and E.

name: 乳转油修复乳
opItems: Heat water of A1 to 75°C and disperse Avicel PC 591 under high shear (2000-2500 rpm) for 15 min.
Prepare premix A2 and add to A1. Mix for 5 min.
Prepare B and heat to 75°C.
Add B to A (75°C) under high shear (rotor stator 2500) for 10 min.
Cool under moderate shear until 50°C then add C.
Increase agitation for 5 min then cool under moderate shear until 35°C.
Add D.
Adjust pH with E.

name: 重焕光彩遮瑕膏
opItems: In the main vessel, weight and heat phase A at 40°C to melt Lipocire™ A SG.
Add phase B and disperse with rotor stator until the phase is homogeneous.

Prepare the pigment phase C: wet pigments with Labrafac™ CC MB and Emulium® Illustro and use a three-roll mill to get a homogeneous paste with no undispersed particles. Add it to phase A+B and disperse the pigment paste with high shear or rotor stator. Check that everything is well dispersed.
Prepare water phase D, heat at 40°C and solubilize the electrolytes.
Proceed with the emulsion of phase D into phase A+B+C at 40°C under medium shear, and then increase to high shear (2500/3000 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Cool down under moderate shear and below 30°C add phase E and the powders of phase F. Mix under moderate shear for 5-10 minutes, until complete incorporation.
Add then phases G and H one by one, under low shear and check that the final product is homogeneous.

name: 焕活护发修复乳
opItems: Prepare A: dissolve Inutec H25P into water and glycerin heated to 70°C.
Under mixing, add Actigum CS 11 QD to A1.
Prepare B and heat to 70°C.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm), add B to A1+A2.
Continue rapid mixing for about 10 min.
Cool under mixing and at about 35°C, add the ingredients of C.
Add perfume and regulate pH with D.

name: 发根再生精华液
opItems: Heat phase A1 at 75°C.
Prepare the premix A2 by wetting Solagum™ AX in propanediol. Add into A1 under medium shear until the gel is formed. Check that everything is homogeneous.
Prepare phase A3 by solubilizing Amphisol® K into water heated at 80°C. Then, add A3 into A1+A2, disperse under medium shear and maintain phase A at 75°C.
Heat phase B at 75°C.
Proceed with the emulsion of phase B into phase A at 75°C under high shear (3000 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Cool down under slow mixing (50 rpm).
Below 30°C, add phases C, D, E and F one by one until homogeneous.
Check pH and adjust if necessary.

name: 头皮&身体磨砂膏
opItems: Heat A to 85°C, maintain at 85°C for 10 min.
Heat B to 75°C under mixing.
Add A to B and mix with a defloculent at 300 rpm for about 3 min.
Heat C to 50°C and add to A+B under mixing.
At 70°C, add D and mix with a defloculent at 400 rpm for about 4 min.
At 65°C, add E and mix at 400 rpm for about 5 min.
At 45°C, add F and mix at 500 rpm. - At 38°C, increase speed mixing at about 600 rpm.
At 35°C, pour the product in a jar.

name: 丝滑面部精华液
opItems: Heat A1 to 75°C and disperse Structure XL for 15 minutes under high shear.
Prepare premix A2. - Add A2 into A1 under moderate shear.
Heat B1 to 70°C.
Add B1 into A under high shear (2500 rpm) at 70°C for 10 minutes.
Cool under moderate shear.
At 50°C add B2 under high shear for 5 minutes, then cool.
Add C bellow 40°C.
Adjust pH with D.

name: 丝感粉底液
opItems: Heat A1 to 50°C and homogenize under stirring (1000 rpm) for 5 min.

Prepare A2: heat Lexfeel Natural and Emulium® Illustro to 60°C and add slowly pigments under stirring, then stir for 10 min. Then use a three roll mill to smooth the dispersion. Add to A1 and homogenize with ultra-turrax for 2 min (10 000 rpm).
Prepare B: heat water to 50°C and add salts under stirring. Mix until complete solubilization.
Add B (50°C) to A (50°C) under mixing and homogenize for 10 min at 1500 rpm.
Cool to 40°C under moderate mixing.
Prepare C and homogenize with ultra-turrax at 10 000 rpm for 2 min.
Add C under mixing.
Then cool under moderate mixing to 27°C and add D, mix for a few minutes.

name: 抗污染面霜
opItems: Disperse Avicel® PC 591 in water under mixing during 10 min.
Then add Satiaxane CX91 + Glycerin, and maintain mixing during 10 min.
Heat A and B to 70-75°C.
Under high shear, add A to B.
Cool under mixing and around 35°C, add C.
Complete cooling under mixing.

name: 柔肤棒
opItems: 将A1加热到85°C，用抹刀混合，直到获得柔软的白色纹理。
将A2加入A1，用刮刀搅拌，然后在去絮凝器下搅拌2分钟，直至均质。
在 85 ° C 加热 A1 + A2
85°C加热B至少15分钟。
在 分散 器下，将 B 加到 A1 + A2 （ 2000 转/分）中 5 分钟，直到形成柔软的淡黄色糊状物。
在 减压 器下冷却至 65 ℃。
用滚边袋（约66°C）将糊状物放入模具中。
在模具中冷却（至少1小时），然后放入冰箱（2小时）以使脱模。

name: 柔顺防护护发乳
opItems: Solubilize Sodium Benzoate into the water of A1 heated to 75°C.
Disperse Jaguar HP-105 into A1 for 10 min under high shear.
Prepare premix A3 and add it to A1+A2 under slow mixing.
Prepare B and heat to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm), add B to A.
Continue rapid mixing for about 10 min.
Cool under mixing and at about 35°C, add the others ingredients.

name: 柔肤棒
opItems: Heat A to 85°C until complete homogenization.
Let the temperature go down to 70°C.
Add B, C and D under moderate mixing for 5 min.
Pour at 55°C into a stick mould.

name: 墨汁精华
opItems: Disperse Exilva of phase A at room temperature into water under high shear (Ultra turrax 10 000 rpm for 10 minutes).
Prepare premix B by wetting xanthan gum with glycerin.
Add phase B into phase A, using a defloculator (moderate shear) for 10 minutes / or Ultra Turrax for 5 min.
Disperse phase C into phase A+B using ultra turrax for 10 minutes until homogenous.
Add phase D under moderate mixing.
Adjust pH with phase E.

name: 星光亮泽精华
opItems: Heat the water of phase A1 at 70°C and disperse Structure® XL for 15 minutes under high shear.
Add premix A2 into A1 under moderate shear for 10 minutes and check that everything is homogeneous. Maintain the temperature at 70°C.
Heat the oil phase B at 70°C. Check that everything is homogeneous.
Proceed with the emulsion of phase B into phase A (A1+A2) at 70°C, under moderate shear, and then increase to high shear (2500 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Cool down under moderate shear and below 35°C add the phase C, D and E one by one.
Add finally the pearls of phase F and mix slowly for 10 minutes.
Finish to cool down until reaching 25°C. Check the pH and adjust if necessary.

name: 定向护理凝胶
opItems: Prepare premix A2.
Add A2 to A1 heated to 45°C, mix for about 10 min.
Cool under mixing and at about 25°C, add B and C.
Complete cooling and add D.
Mix for about 5 min and adjust pH with E.

name: 补水身体乳
opItems: Disperse Naviance Tapioca into A at room temperature.
Heat while mixing until 75°C, maintain for 30 min.
Add B and continue mixing.
Prepare C and heat to 65°C.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm), add C at 65°C to A+B at 65°C.
Maintain rapid mixing for about 10 min.
Cool under mixing and, at about 35°C, add the other ingredients.

name: 紧致弹润身体黄油
opItems: Heat water of A1 to 75°C and disperse Avicel PC 591 using a propeller (2000 rpm) for 20 min.
Prepare premix A2 and add to A1 under moderate mixing for 5 min.
Heat B1 to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm) add B1 to A and maintain mixing for 5 min.
Cool and add B2 at 50°C. Maintain mixing for 5 min (1500 rpm).
Cool and add C at 30°C.
Complete cooling under mixing.

name: 超哑光遮瑕
opItems: In the main vessel, heat phase A at around 45°C to melt Lipocire™ A SG.
Add ingredients of phase B one by one and disperse with Ultra Turrax for 5 minutes. Check that everything is dispersed homogeneously.

Prepare the pigment phase C: wet pigments with Cetiol® CC and Emulium® Illustro and use a three roll mill to get a homogeneous paste. Add then to phase A+B and disperse the pigment paste with high shear or Ultra Turrax.
Prepare water phase D and solubilize the electrolytes. Heat at 45°C.
Proceed with the emulsion of phase D into phase A+B+C at 45°C under medium shear, and then increase to high shear (3000 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Cool down under moderate shear and below 35°C add the powders of phase E. Mix under moderate shear for 5-10 minutes.
Add then phase F.

name: 超平滑眼周眼霜

specRows.label: Aspect
specRows.value: Smooth white cream with a foamy texture

opItems: Prepare A1, heat water at 60°C and add the starch under mixing, mix for about 10 min then add A2 and mix quickly for about 10 minutes more.
Prepare A3: Solubilize SSG into water by heating (60°C).
Add phase A3 to A1+A2 and heat to 75°C.
Prepare phase B and heat to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (3000 rpm), add B to A, mix for about 10 min.
Cool under moderate mixing and at 35°C add C.
Adjust pH with D

name: 多用途面霜
opItems: Under mixing, disperse Avicel® PC 591 for about 15 min, then Satiaxane CX91 for about 10 min into water of B heated to 75-80°C.
Prepare A and heat to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm), add A to B at 75°C and maintain rapid mixing for about 10 min.
Cool under mixing and at about 35°C, add C.
Complete cooling

name: 洁净精华
opItems: Heat water and Original Extract™ Lemon Bio to 75°C and disperse Actigum under high shear for 15 min.
Prepare premix A2 and add into A1 under medium shear.
Add A3 to A1+A2 (not transparent) at 70°C.
Mix A under medium shear (1500 rpm) and cool to 50°C.
Add B to A1+A2+A3 at 50°C under high shear for 5 min (3000 rpm).
Cool under medium shear and below 40°C add C and D. - Adjust pH with E.

name: 抗衰老日霜
opItems: Prepare A and heat to 75°C.
Predisperse Solagum AX into glycerin and add to water of B heated to 75°C, mix for about 10 min.
Under vacuum and rapid mixing (2500 rpm), add A heated (75°C) to B (75°C).
Mix for about 10 min at 2500 rpm and cool under moderate mixing (1500 rpm).
Add C at about 35°C, then add the other ingredients one by one.

name: 青春守护精华液
opItems: Disperse Kelco-Care™ Diutan Gum into A2.
Add A2 in A1 heated to 65°C under mixing and maintain for 20 min. Then add A3 and mix for 5 min.
Heat B to 65°C and add to A under mixing.
Cool under mixing and at about 25°C, add C.
Complete cooling under mixing.

name: 零油光面霜
opItems: Prepare phase A and heat to 75°C.
Disperse C into B heated to 75°C under mixing, mix for about 10 min under high shear.
Add D to B+C and mix for about 10 min under high shear.
Prepare F: add Eumulgin® SG to water under slow mixing until complete dissolution (heat if necessary).
Add E then F to B+C+D and heat to 75°C.
Under rapid mixing (rotor stator 3000 rpm), add A to B+C+D+E+F and maintain rapid mixing for about 10 min.
Cool to 35°C then add G, H, I and J.
Complete cooling.
